title: CloudEvents envelope used by every Likho event

id.description: Unique per event; also sent as the Nats-Msg-Id header so a retried publish is stored once

source.description: The service that published the event

subject.description: The recording, transcript or workspace the event is about

traceparent.description: W3C trace context, so one call can be followed across services

actor.description: User id that caused the event, when a person did
